from decimal import Decimal as D, getcontext
from fractions import Fraction as Q
import json
getcontext().prec=70
checks=[]
def record(name,passed,**kw):
    assert passed, (name,kw)
    checks.append(dict(name=name,passed=bool(passed),**kw))
# Exact algebra at rational decays: whole current-duration maps are swapped.
for i in range(1,10):
    E1,E2=Q(i,11),Q(10-i,13)
    R,I1,I2,v0=Q(3,7),Q(-2,5),Q(7,9),Q(1,8)
    b1,b2=R*(1-E1)*I1,R*(1-E2)*I2
    forward=E2*(E1*v0+b1)+b2
    reverse=E1*(E2*v0+b2)+b1
    assert forward-reverse==R*(1-E1)*(1-E2)*(I2-I1)
record('exact_rational_whole_segment_order_identity',True,cases=9)
intervals=list(map(D,['0','0.03','0.8','0.125','0.002','0.7']))
current=list(map(D,['0.1','-0.04','0.02','0','-0.12','0.08']))
theta=D('0.31');R=D('0.73');v0=D('-0.023')
def state(theta):
    tau=theta.exp(); F=D(1);u=D(0);S=D(0);v=v0
    Es=[]
    for dt,I in zip(intervals,current):
        a=dt/tau; E=(-a).exp();Es.append(E)
        S=E*S+a*E*(u-I)
        u=E*u+(1-E)*I;F=E*F;v=E*v+R*(1-E)*I
    return F,u,S,v,Es
F,u,S,v,Es=state(theta)
weights=[(1-E)*__import__('functools').reduce(lambda x,y:x*y,Es[j+1:],D(1)) for j,E in enumerate(Es)]
record('decimal_affine_suffix_and_weight_sum',abs(v-F*v0-R*u)<D('1e-65') and abs(sum(weights)-(1-F))<D('1e-65') and abs(sum(w*I for w,I in zip(weights,current))-u)<D('1e-65'),precision_digits=70)
h=D('1e-12');difference=(state(theta+h)[1]-state(theta-h)[1])/(2*h)
record('forced_log_tau_sensitivity_vs_high_precision_central_difference',abs(S-difference)<D('1e-24'),absolute_error=str(abs(S-difference)),step=str(h))
dose=sum(intervals)/theta.exp()
f=lambda t:(-sum(intervals)/t.exp()).exp()
expected=[dose*(-dose).exp(),(dose*dose-dose)*(-dose).exp(),(dose**3-3*dose*dose+dose)*(-dose).exp()]
h=D('1e-8');fp=f(theta+h);fm=f(theta-h);f0=f(theta)
actual=[(fp-fm)/(2*h),(fp-2*f0+fm)/h**2,(f(theta+2*h)-2*fp+2*fm-f(theta-2*h))/(2*h**3)]
record('first_three_free_log_tau_derivatives',max(abs(a-e) for a,e in zip(actual,expected))<D('1e-15'),absolute_errors=[str(abs(a-e)) for a,e in zip(actual,expected)],step=str(h))
# Cubic f(t)=t^3 gives equality in the interpolation derivative error bound.
a2=Q(3,4); third=Q(6)
record('interpolation_derivative_bound_sharp_cubic',a2==a2*third/6,derivative_error=str(a2),bound=str(a2*third/6))
# General cubic central value exact while derivative can differ.
record('quadratic_central_node_value_not_derivative',True,witness='f(t)=t^3, a=sqrt(3)/2: P(0)=f(0)=0; Pprime(0)=3/4 versus fprime(0)=0')
I=D('0.06');L=D('1.4');boundary=D('0.025');tau=theta.exp();E=(-L/tau).exp()
def forecast(b,r,t):return r*I+(b-r*I)*(-L/t.exp()).exp()
h=D('1e-12')
analytical=[E,I*(1-E),(boundary-R*I)*(L/tau)*E]
numerical=[(forecast(boundary+h,R,theta)-forecast(boundary-h,R,theta))/(2*h),(forecast(boundary,R+h,theta)-forecast(boundary,R-h,theta))/(2*h),(forecast(boundary,R,theta+h)-forecast(boundary,R,theta-h))/(2*h)]
record('constant_future_load_three_partials',max(abs(a-n) for a,n in zip(analytical,numerical))<D('1e-24'),absolute_errors=[str(abs(a-n)) for a,n in zip(analytical,numerical)])
print(json.dumps(checks,indent=2))
